name: Morita Miku
source:
A fighter at the cosplay fighting pub Bride. [url=/c74644]Yanagishita[/url] is one of her biggest fans at the bar.

In middle school, she had been Japan's bonsai champion. She took up martial arts at [url=/c73543]Midorikawa[/url]'s suggestion.
